The election coincided with the [[2024 United States presidential election|2024 U.S. presidential election]], as well as [[2024 United States House of Representatives elections|other elections]] to the U.S. House, [[2024 United States Senate elections|elections]] to the [[United States Senate]], and various other [[2024 United States elections|state and local elections]]. The primary elections were held on June 11, 2024. Incumbent [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] representative [[Kelly Armstrong]] was re-elected with 62.2% of the vote in 2022 against an independent candidate. He did not seek re-election in 2024, instead choosing to [[2024 North Dakota gubernatorial election|run for governor]]. Incumbent Public Service Commissioner [[Julie Fedorchak]] won the Republican primary and defeated the Democratic challenger, Trygve Hammer, in the general election with 69 percent of the vote. ==
